run_finetune_causal_lm: run fine-tuning of a causal language model on a dataset using DeepSpeed with Accelerator
run_evaluate_model: run evaluation of a fine-tuned causal language model and return perplexity and eval loss
run_parse_cli_args: run parsing of command-line arguments for dataset, model, training hyperparameters, and output configuration
run_resume_training: run resuming training from a checkpoint by loading accelerator state and skipping initial batches
run_save_best_model: run saving the best model checkpoint during training based on lowest perplexity metric
